pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify system status before claiming information availability
lesson.when: A customer asks about stored details or specific system records not supported by available sources
lesson.do: State clearly that the information cannot be verified from available records without asserting system capabilities or limitations
lesson.otherwise: Invent unsupported claims about system status or data availability
